text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 14: Of the eight products tested, CAMS's implied capacity swings the most with the seasons'
text.tspan: Figure 14: Of the eight products tested, CAMS's implied capacity swings

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Implied capacity: metered output over what a south-facing panel at 30° tilt predicts per megawatt. Each point: that calendar month against the generator's annual mean. Closer to zero means steadier; this study cannot say which product is right. Exploratory; no interval is drawn. Hours with no curtailment cap and the sun above 10°. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026.'
text.tspan: Implied capacity: metered output over what a south-facing panel at 30° tilt predicts per megawatt.
Each point: that calendar month against the generator's annual mean. Closer to zero means steadier; this study
cannot say which product is right.
Exploratory; no interval is drawn. Hours with no curtailment cap and the sun above 10°.
Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026.
